targetCertificate.admissibleDegreeLattice: j>80 and j congruent to 1 modulo 3
targetCertificate.classification: all-order exact fixed-charge theorem covering every admissible tail degree j>80 at input charge s=-1
targetCertificate.proof: q=-1 terms vanish; q=0 and q>=2 terms increase with t=1/j; only q=1 terms decrease. Their derivative magnitude is at most Qhat on 0<=t<=1/82, while the (i,q)=(1,2) seed contributes r(3+2t)>=3r. The exact inequality 3r-Qhat>0 makes the complete column strictly increasing in t, so its maximum is the true lattice endpoint j=82.
